parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the Bengali language module rules. Ensured the hook opens with a native word ('Ei bochhor'). Swapped the regional reference from UP to West Bengal for local relevance. Swapped the language self-reference to 'Bangla-te'. Used the polite 'apni' register for Miss Nova and viewer-facing lines while maintaining a highly colloquial, code-mixed spoken tone (avoiding any formal Sanskritized/sadhu-bhasha vocabulary). Kept all brand names, product terms, and numbers in English as mandated.
